title: Identity, Access & Governance
description: Master AWS IAM, Organizations, IAM Identity Center, Control Tower, and cost management tools.
longDescription: Security is job zero at AWS. In this module, you will learn how to control who can access your AWS account and what they can do. You will explore IAM users, groups, roles, and policies; set up AWS Organizations and organizational units; implement single sign-on with IAM Identity Center; and use governance tools like Control Tower, Config, and CloudTrail.
whatYouLearn: Create IAM users, groups, roles, and policies
Implement governance with Control Tower and CloudTrail
